title: Giten Megami Tensei: Tokyo Mokushiroku — English translation
requires: your own copy of Giten Megami Tensei: Tokyo Mokushiroku (ASCII / Atlus, April 1997, PC-98 retail release), installed on a PC-98 hard-disk image (.hdi / .nhd) with the DDS98 folder, unmodified: DDS98.EXE 480,710 bytes, CRC32 2E4FA3C2. On a fast emulator limit the CPU to about 50 MHz: map and battle speed follow the CPU clock
credits: Original game (c) 1997 Atlus / ASCII / Fumito Nishitani / SHIPS
